# Credits & Pricing

> Learn how to get and manage your Tavily API Credits.

## Free API Credits

<Card icon="key" href="https://app.tavily.com" title="Get your free API key" horizontal>
  You get 1,000 free API Credits every month. **No credit card required.**
</Card>

## Pricing Overview

Tavily operates on a simple, credit-based model:

* **Free**: 1,000 credits/month
* **Pay-as-you-go**: \$0.008 per credit (allows you to be charged per credit once your plan’s credit limit is reached).
* **Monthly plans**: \$0.0075 - \$0.005 per credit
* **Enterprise**: Custom pricing and volume

| **Plan**          | **Credits per month** | **Monthly price** | **Price per credit** |
| ----------------- | --------------------- | ----------------- | -------------------- |
| **Researcher**    | 1,000                 | Free              | -                    |
| **Project**       | 4,000                 | \$30              | \$0.0075             |
| **Bootstrap**     | 15,000                | \$100             | \$0.0067             |
| **Startup**       | 38,000                | \$220             | \$0.0058             |
| **Growth**        | 100,000               | \$500             | \$0.005              |
| **Pay as you go** | Per usage             | \$0.008 / Credit  | \$0.008              |
| **Enterprise**    | Custom                | Custom            | Custom               |

Head to [billing](https://app.tavily.com/billing) to explore our different options and manage your plan.

## API Credits Costs

### Tavily Search

Your [search depth](/api-reference/endpoint/search#body-search-depth) determines the cost of your request.

* **Basic Search (`basic`):**
  Each request costs **1 API credit**.

* **Advanced Search (`advanced`):**
Each request costs **2 API credits**.

### Tavily Extract

The number of successful URL extractions and your [extraction depth](/api-reference/endpoint/extract#body-extract-depth) determines the cost of your request. You never get charged if a URL extraction fails.

* **Basic Extract (`basic`):**
  Every 5 successful URL extractions cost **1 API credit**

* **Advanced Extract (`advanced`):**
  Every 5 successful URL extractions cost **2 API credits**

### Tavily Map

The number of pages mapped and whether or not natural-language [instructions](/documentation/api-reference/endpoint/map#instructions) are specified determines the cost of your request. You never get charged if a map request fails.

* **Regular Mapping:**
  Every 10 successful pages returned cost **1 API credit**

* **Map with (`instructions`):**
  Every 10 successful pages returned cost **2 API credits**

### Tavily Crawl

Tavily Crawl combines both mapping and extraction operations, so the cost is the sum of both:
* **Crawl Cost = Mapping Cost + Extraction Cost**

For example:

* If you crawl 10 pages with basic extraction depth, you'll be charged **1 credit for mapping** (10 pages) + **2 credits for extraction** (10 successful extractions ÷ 5) = **3 total credits**
* If you crawl 10 pages with advanced extraction depth, you'll be charged **1 credit for mapping** + **4 credits for extraction** = **5 total credits**

### Tavily Research

Tavily Research follows a dynamic
pricing model with minimum and maximum credit consumption boundaries associated
with each request. The minimum and maximum boundaries differ based on if the
request uses `model=mini` or `model=pro`.

| Request Cost Boundaries | model=pro   | model=mini  |
| ----------------------- | ----------- | ----------- |
| Per-request minimum     | 15 credits  | 4 credits   |
| Per-request maximum     | 250 credits | 110 credits |

# Pricing

Last updated 1 year ago

At Tavily, we offer flexible pricing plans to suit different users, from individual researchers to growing teams and enterprises. Whether you need a free plan to get started or a scalable solution to support your business, we have the right plan for you. Below is an overview of our pricing options.

## **Free Plan: Researcher**

* **Price** : Free / Month
* **Who is it for?** New creators and individuals exploring Tavily.
* **Features** :
  
    + 1,000 API credits per month
    + No credit card required
    + Email support

## **Project Plan**

* **Price** : $30 / Month
* **Who is it for?** Enthusiasts who require more API usage.
* **Features** :
  
    + 4,000 API credits per month
+ Adjustable plan with a sliding scale
    + Higher rate limits
    + Email support

## **Bootstrap Plan**

* **Price** : $100 / Month
* **Who is it for?** Small teams that need a scalable search solution.
* **Features** :
  
    + 15,000 API credits per month
    + Adjustable plan with a sliding scale
    + Higher rate limits
    + Email support

## **Startup Plan**

* **Price** : $220 / Month
* **Who is it for?** Businesses requiring more capacity and scalability.
* **Features** :
  
    + 38,000 API credits per month
    + Adjustable plan with a sliding scale
    + Higher rate limits
    + Email support

## **Growth Plan**

* **Price** : $500 / Month
* **Who is it for?** Companies scaling up their search capabilities.
* **Features** :
  
    + 100,000 API credits per month
    + Adjustable plan with a sliding scale
    + Higher rate limits
    + Email support

## **Pay-As-You-Go Plan**

* **Price** : $0.008 / Credit
* **Who is it for?
** Users who prefer a flexible, usage-based model.
* **Features** :
  
    + Pay only for what you use
    + Cancel anytime
    + Email support

## [**Enterprise Plan**](https://tavily.com/enterprise)

* **Price** : Custom pricing
* **Who is it for?** Large organizations with custom needs.
* **Features** :
  
    + Custom API calls
    + Custom rate limits
    + Enterprise-grade support and SLAs
    + Enterprise-grade security and privacy
    + Custom seats

### **Which Plan is Right for You?**

If you're just getting started, the **Researcher (Free) plan** is perfect for exploring Tavily’s capabilities. If you require more frequent API usage, the **Project, Bootstrap, Startup, or Growth plans** offer increasing levels of resources. Businesses and teams needing flexibility may prefer the **Pay-As-You-Go** model, while [enterprises](https://tavily.com/enterprise) can work with us to build a **custom solution** that fits their needs.

### **How to Upgrade or Change Your Plan**
You can easily manage your subscription by visiting your [Billing page](https://app.tavily.com/billing) . Adjust your plan at any time based on your usage and needs.

**Benefits:**

* List item Improved Search Accuracy: Users can narrow down search results to specific time frames, leading to more relevant results.

* Increased Productivity: Saves time for users who need to find information within certain date ranges.
